title: 7.20.3 Lab: Duel a classmate
description: H hosts a duel, Red against Blue, with a classmate on another computer: a choice sends { act, roll }, act runs in onMove only for the seat whose turn it is and only for a good move, and the campaign still plays offline.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: This is your game from 7.19.3. It plays on one computer; H does nothing yet.
hints: If you brought your 7.19.3 work forward, your names may differ; keep yours. Where a step quotes a line, change the line of yours that does the same job.

steps.title: A duel flag, and Red against Blue
steps.instructions: At the top, below the comment lines, add `const JOIN = '';`. Below `let over = false;`, add `let duel = false;`. In `newGame()`, put the three lines that make the enemies and the fighters inside the `else` of an `if (duel)`: `if (duel) { fighters = [new Fighter('Red', 30, 3, 2, 'tomato'), new Fighter('Blue', 30, 3, 2, 'dodgerblue')]; } else { ...your three lines... }`. Change the first message to `message = duel ? 'Red goes first: 1 attack, 2 guard, 3 potion' : 'Your turn: 1 attack, 2 guard, 3 potion';`. Run: the campaign plays as before, because `duel` is false.
hints: Red and Blue get the same numbers, so the duel is a fair fight.

steps.title: A room and a listener
steps.instructions: At the end of `setup()`, apply every move that arrives: `online.onMove((m, seat) => { if (duel && !over) act(turn, m.act, m.roll); });`. Below it, join a room when there is a code: `if (JOIN !== '') { duel = true; newGame(); online.join(JOIN); }`. In `draw()`, below `background(...)`, H hosts a duel: `if (kb.presses('h') && !duel && online.status === 'off') { duel = true; newGame(); online.host(); }`.
hints: Without `newGame()`, the hurt hero from your campaign would be in the duel on your computer, while your classmate's starts fresh, and the two would never match.
The next steps send the moves, and check each one before `act` runs it.

steps.title: Send the move, do not make it
steps.instructions: In `choose(a)`, roll first, then send or act: `const roll = floor(random(0, 4));`, then `if (duel) online.send({ act: a, roll: roll });` and `else act(turn, a, roll);`. In `act`, the computer enemy only plays when this is not a duel: change `if (turn === 1) after(45, enemyTurn);` to `if (!duel && turn === 1) after(45, enemyTurn);`. At the very top of `fightOver(winner)`: `if (duel) { over = true; message = fighters[winner].name + ' wins the duel! Run again to play again'; return; }`.
hints: The sender rolls, once, and sends the roll: then both computers use the same roll, and the hp bars agree.
Online, an action done where you press the key AND in `onMove` would happen twice on your screen.

steps.title: Check every move that arrives
steps.instructions: Below `newGame()`, add the check from the reading: `function goodMove(m) { return m !== null && typeof m === 'object' && [1, 2, 3].includes(m.act) && [0, 1, 2, 3].includes(m.roll); }`. Below it, `myTurn()`: `if (!duel) return turn === 0;` and then `return online.status === 'ready' && online.seat === turn;`. Make `onMove` check before it acts: `if (duel && !over && seat === turn && goodMove(m)) act(turn, m.act, m.roll);`. In `draw()`, the key block starts with `if (!over && myTurn())` instead of `if (!over && turn === 0)`, and R only works offline: add `&& !duel` to the R test.
hints: Seat 0 is the host and plays Red, `fighters[0]`; seat 1 is the classmate and plays Blue.
A move like `{ act: '1', roll: 0 }` holds the word '1', not the number 1, so `goodMove` ignores it on both computers.

steps.title: Show the room, then duel
steps.instructions:
In `drawTop()`, the Fight line is only for the campaign: `if (!duel) text('Fight ' + (which + 1) + ' of ' + enemies.length + '    H: duel a classmate', 10, 46, 12, '#8393c4');`. Below it, one line for each status of a duel: `'waiting'`, the code big enough to read and type, `text('Room code: ' + online.code, 10, 50, 18, 'gold')`; `'ready'`, `text('Online duel: you are ' + fighters[online.seat].name + '. Turn: ' + fighters[turn].name, 10, 46, 12, 'gold')`; `'closed'`, `'Room closed: one hosts (H), one joins the new code'` at size 12; and `'error'`, `('' + online.error).slice(0, 60)` at size 12 in `'tomato'`. Each one starts `if (duel && online.status === 'waiting')` and so on. Then host in one tab, join from a second tab (or a classmate's computer), and duel.

**To duel again:** stop and Run again in both tabs. Only ONE player presses H; the other puts the NEW code in `JOIN` and runs again. If both press H, you are in two different rooms.
hints: You must be signed in and in a class to play online.
The canvas is 480 pixels wide: keep each line short, and start them near the left edge.
Press a key when it is not your turn: nothing happens, on either computer.

requirements.title: A choice sends the action and its roll
requirements.description: In a duel, the action and its roll are sent with online.send instead of being done on the spot. Help: 7.20.1 (Reading: Same battle, a classmate takes the other turn)

requirements.title: act runs in onMove
requirements.description: Every move that arrives runs act, on both computers. Help: 7.20.1 (Reading: Same battle, a classmate takes the other turn)

requirements.title: It checks the seat and the move
requirements.description: Before onMove acts, it checks that the seat that sent the move is the seat whose turn it is, and that the move is good. Help: 7.20.1 (Reading: Same battle, a classmate takes the other turn)
requirements.hint: if (duel && !over && seat === turn && goodMove(m)) act(turn, m.act, m.roll);

requirements.title: The campaign still works offline
requirements.description: One test picks: in a duel the move is sent; otherwise it is done straight away. Help: 7.20.1 (Reading: Same battle, a classmate takes the other turn)
requirements.hint: if (duel) online.send({ act: a, roll: roll }); else act(turn, a, roll);

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Lab: Duel a classmate". The task: make Quest playable as a duel across two computers: a duel flag; newGame makes Red against Blue in a duel and the run of enemies otherwise; set up online.onMove once to run act for each arriving move only in a duel, while it is not over, when the seat that sent it is the seat whose turn it is and goodMove says the action is 1 to 3 and the roll 0 to 3 (whole numbers); host on H, or join from a JOIN code; on a choice, roll once and send { act, roll } with online.send in a duel instead of acting; let only the seat whose turn it is choose; the computer enemy and R only offline; and keep the campaign working offline. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.

rubric.title: Send
rubric.description: A choice sends the action and roll.

rubric.title: Checks
rubric.description: Wrong seat or a bad move is ignored.
